header.title: P.Oxy. 67 4581: Astrampsychus; Sortes 29, 30, 32, 33, 65-68, 70, 72-74, 93-97 and higher (previously unattested; till 208): AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek magical papyri and amulets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:59322:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY 4.0: credit papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (the source's own licence is CC BY 3.0) and this AI translation.

notes.2.7: Answers from the Sortes Astrampsychi; most of each line is the editor’s restoration. Dotted letters, including the number λγ (33) in 2.10, are doubtful. πεφαρμάκωσαι may mean ‘bewitched’ as well as ‘poisoned’.

nodes.text: You do not complete what [you are undertaking].
33 You are [not] re[conciled to your masters].
Do not gi[ve the documents just now].
